title: Beetle Sorcerer Ritual
description: A hooded figure with a beetle-like head and glowing white eyes sits cross-legged on a large circular occult sigil. The dark robe is covered in small white beetles, with additional beetles floating in glowing rings around the hands and head. In the background stands a large silhouetted beetle structure with glowing orbs.
prompt: A hooded sorcerer with a black beetle head and glowing white eyes sits in a meditative pose on a large intricate circular sigil filled with runes and beetles. The long flowing dark robe is covered in small white beetles. Multiple glowing rings of light float around the figure with beetles suspended inside them. The hands emit a soft glow. In the dark background is a large silhouetted beetle-like structure with glowing orbs and bokeh lights.
